restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.body: Replace everything in this Bayplan with the contents of a backup file.

confirm.title: Restore this backup?
confirm.body: This replaces all users, teams, access, settings, environments and audit entries in this Bayplan with the backup's. Everyone is signed out, including you. Bayplan saves a snapshot first, so you can go back.

errors.check: Couldn't check this backup. Check the container logs, then try again.

overlay.title: Restoring…
overlay.body: Don't close this page. This takes a moment.

done.heading: Backup restored
done.body: You were signed out. Sign in with an account from the backup.
done.agents: Agents reconnect on their own once your public URL points at this Bayplan. Agents installed after the backup was taken are listed under Settings → Environments.
done.notice: Backup restored. Sign in with an account from the backup.
